title: "Satellite Walker" idea comes to life with Astra on Ultra
author: PykeTheTitan
selftext:
Im amazed with Astra's ability to go all the way from 0-100 making a full custom rigged model. I started with an image produced completely from my verbal description, into telling it to use blender MCP to model and rig the mob with hit boxes, animation, and then finally random spawning in the procedural world. I'm planning on making it a lot taller but this a great start. Just seeing one of these for the first time while playing in my world added so much to the feel of the world

I'm excited to see my world start to get a personality, theme and atmosphere that I can continue to build
